LOOK: Protesters hold tombstones representing lives lost to alcohol during a Halloween-themed creative action led by the Sin Tax Coalition at the Boy Scout Circle in Quezon City on Tuesday, October 28.

The protest urges lawmakers to pass stronger alcohol control measures, including higher alcohol taxes, to protect young people. 

📷: Santi San Juan | MB
